name: Widget Drawer
author: Taylor Burke
description: Park bar widgets you aren't using in a drawer instead of uninstalling them. Their plugins stay installed and running; one click puts them back.

barWidget.description: One icon holding the widgets you've parked; click to park or restore widgets.

schema.label: Park widgets dropped in the tray drawer
schema.description: Drag a bar widget into the tray's drawer and it is parked here automatically. Turn off if you use the tray drawer for widgets you want to keep on the bar.
